  • Method Details

    • update

      public double update(double newValue)
      Updates both source indicators with the same input value and applies the bi-function to their results. Both indicators receive the same raw input, enabling operations like diff(indicatorA, indicatorB).
      Specified by:
      update in interface RTIndicator
      Overrides:
      update in class AbstractRTIndicator
      Parameters:
      newValue - the input value forwarded to both indicators
      Returns:
      the result of applying the bi-function to both indicator outputs
